source_excerpts.text:
Inventories and complete campaign boundary

The campaign restores eight face kits and eight strut kits. It includes 500 returned-kit cleaning/inspection operations and 20 paid fault-cartridge bench resets.

Campaign item	Prospective allowance
Initial consumable-stock cash	$10,310
Consumed fault/reject stocks	$8,120
Unused stock returned	$2,190
Sixteen circulating kits, already in first build	$3,440
Operating cash excluding first-stock purchase	$23,950
Complete campaign economic cost	$35,103
Human work, including independent testing	108.67 h
Complete purchased campaign energy	105.112 kWh

The energy total includes 17.5 kWh of full-cell auxiliary allowance, 50 kWh for independent load-source/metrology operation and 4 kWh for cold setup, in addition to the local model.

The full six-axis load source remains an explicit construction gap: its paid allowance does not yet prove that it can maintain the intended wrench without introducing a stiff bypass.
